# routeur_anomaly_detector (Resource)

An anomaly detector in a workspace. It compares traffic over a window against a threshold (volume, cost, latency or error rate) and raises an event when it is exceeded; depending on `action` it can also refuse matching requests while the event is open.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "platform" {
  slug = "platform"
  name = "Platform"
}

# Alert when spend in a day passes $500 (the threshold is in US cents).
resource "routeur_anomaly_detector" "daily_spend" {
  workspace_id   = routeur_workspace.platform.id
  name           = "Daily spend"
  type           = "cost_spike"
  threshold      = { amount_cents = 50000 }
  window_minutes = 1440
  action         = "alert"
}

# Refuse traffic while more than 5% of calls fail over 15 minutes.
resource "routeur_anomaly_detector" "errors" {
  workspace_id   = routeur_workspace.platform.id
  name           = "Error burst"
  type           = "error_burst"
  threshold      = { error_rate_pct = 5 }
  window_minutes = 15
  action         = "block"
}

resource "routeur_anomaly_detector" "latency" {
  workspace_id   = routeur_workspace.platform.id
  name           = "Slow responses"
  type           = "latency_spike"
  threshold      = { p95_ms = 8000 }
  window_minutes = 60
  action         = "alert"
}

resource "routeur_anomaly_detector" "volume" {
  workspace_id   = routeur_workspace.platform.id
  name           = "Traffic surge"
  type           = "volume_spike"
  threshold      = { baseline_pct = 300 }
  window_minutes = 30
  action         = "alert"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `alert` records an event; `quarantine` and `block` also refuse matching requests while the event is open (HTTP 429, `anomaly_block_active`); `throttle` is stored but not enforced.
- `name` (String) Unique in the workspace, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `threshold` (Attributes) The limit that raises an event. Set exactly one argument, the one that belongs to `type`: `baseline_pct` for `volume_spike`, `amount_cents` for `cost_spike`, `p95_ms` for `latency_spike`, `error_rate_pct` for `error_burst`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--threshold))
- `type` (String) What the detector watches: `volume_spike`, `cost_spike`, `latency_spike` or `error_burst`. Set the matching `threshold` argument and no other. Changing the type updates the detector in place.
- `window_minutes` (Number) Evaluation window in minutes: 5, 15, 30, 60, 180, 360, 720 or 1440.
- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the detector is evaluated. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the detector again.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the detector (`anom_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

<a id="nestedatt--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threshold`

Optional:

- `amount_cents` (Number) US cents, an integer from 1 to 1000000000. Only with `type = "cost_spike"`.
- `baseline_pct` (Number) Percent over the baseline, an integer from 1 to 10000000. Only with `type = "volume_spike"`.
- `error_rate_pct` (Number) Error rate in percent, from 0.01 to 100. Only with `type = "error_burst"`.
- `p95_ms` (Number) 95th-percentile latency in milliseconds, an integer from 1 to 10000000. Only with `type = "latency_spike"`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>/<detector_id>
import {
  to = routeur_anomaly_detector.daily_spend
  id = "ws_3/anom_12"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>/<detector_id>
terraform import routeur_anomaly_detector.daily_spend ws_3/anom_12
```
